name: 49731-specdecode-8b-4gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3-8B (target) + deepseek-ai/dspark_qwen3_8b_block7 (DSpark drafter). Both public and ungated; real weights.
hardware: 4x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, all in ONE node, NVLink between them.
parallelism: TP=4, PP=1, DP=1. One in-process engine (guidellm `vllm_python`), no router, no external cache tier. The draft model inherits the target's tensor-parallel degree.
architecture: Qwen3ForCausalLM target: 36 layers, 32 query / 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, hidden 4096, vocab 151936, bf16, 8.19B params = 16.4 GB. Drafter: 5-layer semi-autoregressive Qwen3DSparkModel reading the target's layers 1/9/17/25/33, block_size 7, markov_rank 256, 2.371B params = 4.74 GB. 21.1 GB of weights, 5.3 GB per rank at TP=4.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, warmup 10% and cooldown 10%, bounded at 1000 requests (800 measured).
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, SINGLE TURN, fixed shape: exactly 32 prompt tokens and exactly 128 output tokens, min = max on both, no variance. Temperature 1.0, prefix caching off, seed 42. WIRE LENGTH IS NOT DECLARED LENGTH: the `vllm_python` backend renders each row as a {"role":"user"} message and applies the chat template, so the engine's own prompt-token count reads a handful above 32; that backend also sets ignore_eos whenever max_tokens is set, so every request emits exactly 128 tokens.
purpose: A single-user chat assistant with draft-model acceleration, answering short prompts with 128-token replies across four GPUs.
launch:
# Engine command line: four H100s of one node, Qwen3-8B with a DSpark block drafter at 7
# speculative tokens, one request at a time.
#
# Flat `key: value` only. An indented line is skipped, so a structured value must stay on ONE
# line or the key is dropped and the engine starts without it.
model: Qwen/Qwen3-8B
speculative-config: {"model": "deepseek-ai/dspark_qwen3_8b_block7", "method": "dspark", "num_speculative_tokens": 7, "draft_sample_method": "probabilistic", "attention_backend": "FLASH_ATTN"}
tensor-parallel-size: 4

# Pinned, not defaults left standing: built in-process the engine does not resolve these two from
# its per-device table and falls through to 2048 / 128, which is a different operating point.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 32

enable-prefix-caching: false
trust-remote-code: true
max-model-len: 4096
# Sized to what this engine needs, not to the card: 5.3 GB of weights per rank, 5.1 GiB of KV at
# the full 32 x 4096 cap, ~4 GiB of activations and graphs -- 14.4 GiB, so 0.40 is 2.2x headroom
# and the KV pool is still 4500x the 6.4 MiB one 160-token stream can occupy. 0.90 wants 71.3 GiB
# FREE on an 80 GB card and these nodes hand over 36; it cost 13 and then 8 `WorkerProc
# initialization failed` cycles before the engine came up at all. See note.md.
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.40
enable-chunked-prefill: true
